title: Resolution urging Albany to regulate AI therapy chatbots
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, S.8484/A.9106, which would regulate the use of artificial intelligence in providing therapy or psychotherapy services. It cites concerns that unregulated AI chatbots may give unvalidated mental health advice, misrepresent themselves as licensed professionals and expose users' health data. The Council notes surveys showing significant shares of adults and youth already use such chatbots for mental health support.”},
